items.title: Lalishrita
items.subtitle: Tamil lullaby, from a phonogram (sketch)
items.source: Fox Strangways, The Music of Hindostan (1914), Ex. 155, p. 64
items.blocked: Transcribe lines three and four, then check every bar against Ex. 155's plate.
items.notes: A SKETCH of the first two lines: Adagio, crotchet 70, taken from a phonogram, so the book's notation has triplets and grace notes; the words are Fox Strangways's singing version. The melody circles G with E below and C above. Every bar wants checking against the plate; the third and fourth lines (I bring thee sleep; On the wings of my melodies) are not read yet.

items.title: The ayah's song
items.subtitle: Hindostani song from the steamer (sketch)
items.source: Fox Strangways, The Music of Hindostan (1914), Ex. 160, p. 66
items.blocked: Check every bar and both cadence slides against Ex. 160's plate.
items.notes: A SKETCH. Adagio, crotchet 80. One of three songs an ayah sang on board the steamer; Fox Strangways says she lost her key and the songs were hard to piece together, and that the slide to the close and the half-close gave them their value. The slide is written here as grace notes before the two cadence notes. The tune falls below the stave to A; sing it a fourth up. No words are printed. Every bar wants checking against the plate.
